endToEndScenarios.evidence: Graph selection and exact-span provenance unit tests pass; one browser-level source-to-visual end-to-end path was not run.

endToEndScenarios.name: Existing application workflow regression
endToEndScenarios.evidence: Full regression suite passed: 15 files, 166 tests, including a globe-to-catalogue-to-source-reader path for Japan APPI.
